variation.name: Player's variation
variation.description: How much each note differs from the last in the virtual player's hands: its air, vibrato and intonation. 100 % as it was fitted, 0 every note alike. From the next note.

dynamics.name: Dynamics
dynamics.description: How the velocity maps to the air: less brings the soft notes up, with more air, so also brighter; more takes them down. 45 dB plays the velocity as it comes.
